layouts.HeroWrapper: MUI Box. maxWidth: '620px', mx: 'auto', pt: { xs: '64px', md: '88px' }. CRITICAL: This reserves clearance for the fixed 64/72px top marketing header so the avatar is never clipped.
layouts.CoverBand: MUI Box. height: { xs: '200px', md: '240px' }, borderRadius: { xs: 0, md: '24px' }, position: 'relative', overflow: 'hidden'. Holds the uploaded cover image or gradient.
layouts.ContentWrapper: MUI Box. display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', mt: { xs: '-100px', md: '-120px' }, position: 'relative', zIndex: 10. This pulls the avatar and text up to overlap the cover elegantly.
layouts.SocialsRow: MUI Box. display: 'flex', justifyContent: 'center', gap: 1.5, mt: 3.

colors.accent: Must map to the creator's theme.accent_color. Fallback: '#4F46E5' (light) / '#818CF8' (dark).
colors.surface: rgba(255,255,255,0.03) in dark mode, rgba(0,0,0,0.02) in light mode

typography.Name: Typography variant='h4'. fontWeight: 800, letterSpacing: '-0.03em', fontSize: { xs: '24px', md: '28px' }, mt: 2.
typography.Handle: Typography. fontFamily: 'Roboto Mono, ui-monospace, monospace', fontSize: '15px', fontWeight: 500, color: 'accent', mt: 0.5, display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center'.
typography.Bio: Typography. fontFamily: 'Inter, sans-serif', fontSize: '15px', lineHeight: 1.6, color: 'text.secondary', maxWidth: '460px', textAlign: 'center', mt: 2.

visual_enhancers.CoverScrim: Absolute inset-0 over the CoverBand. background: `linear-gradient(to bottom, ${alpha(theme.palette.background.default, 0)} 20%, ${alpha(theme.palette.background.default, 0.95)} 100%)`. This blends the bottom of the cover into the background and ensures text contrast.
visual_enhancers.BareAmbientGlow: Used in place of CoverBand when there is no cover. height: { xs: '160px', md: '200px' }, background: `radial-gradient(ellipse at top center, ${alpha(accentColor, 0.25)} 0%, ${alpha(theme.palette.background.default, 0)} 70%)`.
visual_enhancers.AvatarGlassRing: For avatars with a photo. boxShadow: `0 0 0 4px ${alpha(theme.palette.background.default, 0.6)}`, border: `1px solid ${theme.palette.divider}`, backdropFilter: 'blur(12px)'.
visual_enhancers.MonogramAvatar: For the bare state. background: `linear-gradient(135deg, ${accentColor}, darkerAccentColor)`, color: '#FFF', boxShadow: `0 8px 32px ${alpha(accentColor, 0.3)}`, border: '2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)'.

motion.SocialButtonHover: transition: 'transform 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease'. :hover { transform: 'translateY(-2px)', borderColor: accentColor, backgroundColor: alpha(accentColor, 0.05) }

accessibility.Contrast: The 95% opacity CoverScrim guarantees WCAG AA contrast for the overlapping Name and Handle text over any bright image or pattern.
accessibility.DataTestId: All interactive elements, buttons, and links MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign ONLY the Hero section in Components/Page/Creator/CreatorProfile.js.
Do NOT alter the tip widget, featured-campaign card, or anything below the hero.
Use MUI v5 Box, Avatar, Typography, and IconButton with the `sx` prop. Import `alpha` from `@mui/material/styles` for dynamic opacity.
Implement the top clearance fix by applying `pt: { xs: '64px', md: '88px' }` to the outermost hero wrapper.
Implement the 'Rich State' using the 240px CoverBand, the CoverScrim gradient, and pull the ContentWrapper up via negative margin.
Implement the 'Bare State' using the BareAmbientGlow background and glowing MonogramAvatar.
Apply the AvatarGlassRing styling to the photo avatar so it transitions beautifully against the cover image.
Preserve all existing component logic, state, and props—only rewrite the rendering layout and styling of the Hero area.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
Do not apply universal transitions (`transition: all`); target specific properties.
Do not center align the app container globally, only specific wrappers.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
